zh-CN.name: 无障碍与伦理设计
zh-CN.description: 结合可感知、可操作、可理解等可访问性要求与透明、尊重选择、最少必要数据等设计责任。它是持续检查任务和影响的原则，不是换成大字号或贴一个无障碍标识即可完成。
use_when: 所有产品的核心任务都应考虑不同使用能力。
涉及权限、数据或用户承诺的选择。
avoid_when: 不能只通过自动评分宣布全面合规。
不要用深色模式或大字体替代完整任务检查。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
检查文字对比、键盘路径、语义标签、错误恢复与减少动态效果；让权限和数据用途清楚可见，选择可撤回；覆盖真实辅助技术与不同用户任务，记录仍未解决的障碍。
专属演示：清楚可撤回的偏好选择、默认关闭的可选数据项和键盘焦点，保存只更新本地演示。 参数：正文字号 {font_size_px}px。

en.name: Accessible & Ethical
en.description: A principle combining accessibility needs with transparency, meaningful choice and appropriate data minimization. It requires ongoing checks of tasks and impacts, not just larger type or an accessibility badge.
use_when: Core product tasks must account for varied abilities.
Choices involve permissions, data or user commitments.
avoid_when: Do not declare full compliance from an automated score alone.
Dark mode or larger type cannot replace complete task checks.
en.prompt_template:
Check contrast, keyboard paths, semantic labels, error recovery and reduced motion. Make permissions and data use visible and allow choices to be reversed. Evaluate real assistive technologies and varied user tasks, recording unresolved barriers.
Dedicated demonstration: Clear reversible preference choices, optional data disabled by default and visible keyboard focus; saving changes only the local demo. Parameters: body size {font_size_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 可供性与意符
zh-CN.description: 操作可能性与可感知的提示需要配合：按钮外观、标签与状态应帮助用户理解下一步。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
为主要操作提供明确的按钮外观与动词标签，让可交互区域有足够尺寸，并保持默认、悬停、焦点、禁用状态一致。
专属演示：普通文字与清楚操作意符并置；真实按钮可触发添加与撤销反馈。 参数：圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Affordance and Signifiers
en.description: Available actions need perceivable cues: appearance, labels, and states should make the next step understandable.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Give primary actions a recognizable button shape and verb label. Use adequately sized targets and consistent default, hover, focus, and disabled states.
Dedicated demonstration: Plain text compared with a clear action signifier; the real button triggers add and undo feedback. Parameters: corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: AI 原生 UI
zh-CN.description: 围绕 AI 的不确定输出、用户输入、校验和修正关系设计的交互方向。它不是在普通界面中添加聊天框，也不能以“AI 原生”暗示所有建议都准确或所有行动都已完成。
use_when: AI 能力是任务核心且输出需要用户检查。
产品能够区分生成、验证和执行阶段。
avoid_when: 不能用流畅文本伪装为已经验证的事实。
模型建议不应默认直接执行重要外部操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
围绕输入、生成、检查与修正组织任务，显示来源、限制与实际执行状态；提供可编辑结果、撤销与非AI替代路径；必要动作由用户确认，不把建议当作已执行结果。
专属演示：输入、模拟建议、人工编辑和确认的独立状态，不调用模型，不把建议当作已执行。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: AI-Native UI
en.description: An interaction direction designed around uncertain AI output, user input, validation and correction. It is not merely a chat box added to an ordinary interface, and the label does not imply that every suggestion is correct or every action is complete.
use_when: AI capabilities are central to the task and outputs need user review.
The product can distinguish generation, validation and execution.
avoid_when: Do not present fluent text as automatically verified fact.
Model suggestions should not automatically execute consequential external actions.
en.prompt_template:
Organize the task around input, generation, review and correction. Show provenance, limitations and actual execution state. Offer editable results, undo and non-AI alternatives; require confirmation where needed and distinguish suggestions from executed outcomes.
Dedicated demonstration: Separate input, simulated suggestion, human edit and confirmation states; no model call and no suggestion presented as an executed action. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 极光 UI
zh-CN.description: 工作用视觉标签：用柔和、多色、边界模糊的渐变光团形成极光般的背景氛围。渐变本身不是鼠标聚光、真实光照模拟或已经实现的动态效果。
use_when: 品牌背景需要柔和的色彩氛围。
前景内容有独立的稳定承载表面。
avoid_when: 变化背景不能持续影响文字对比。
不应默认使用持续移动的大面积光团。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
以少量柔和多色渐变作为背景，前景文字和操作保持稳定对比；渐变不遮挡组件边界；如增加缓慢变化，提供静态替代与减少动态效果支持，不把装饰称为真实照明。
专属演示：独立柔和光团构成多色极光，重播产生有限渐变漂移，减少动态时静止。 参数：视觉强度 {intensity}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Aurora UI
en.description: A working visual label for soft multicolor gradients with diffuse boundaries that evoke an aurora-like background. A gradient alone is not a cursor spotlight, physical lighting simulation or an implemented animation.
use_when: The brand background benefits from soft color atmosphere.
Foreground content has its own stable surface.
avoid_when: Changing backgrounds must not undermine text contrast.
Do not default to large continuously moving color fields.
en.prompt_template:
Use a limited number of soft multicolor gradients in the background while keeping foreground text and actions consistently legible. Preserve component boundaries. If slow animation is added, provide a static alternative and reduced-motion support; do not label decoration as physical lighting.
Dedicated demonstration: Soft independent color blobs form an aurora; replay a finite drift, static under reduced motion. Parameters: visual intensity {intensity}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 便当盒网格
zh-CN.description: 用共用栅格组织大小不同的内容卡片，卡片分别承载一个主题，形成类似便当分区的模块化布局。它是页面组织方式，不要求所有卡片都能点击。
use_when: 产品功能或内容可分成多个独立主题。
需要用卡片大小突出不同信息层级。
avoid_when: 内容必须按连续步骤阅读时，不要强行切碎。
移动端不能只缩小桌面宫格，应保留阅读顺序。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
把内容按主题分成卡片，使用统一列网格和一致的间距；重要主题可跨列，次要主题保持紧凑；窄屏按阅读顺序单列排列，交互卡片与信息卡片使用不同提示。
专属演示：大小不同的主题块共享栅格，重要主题跨行，信息块与操作块明确区分。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Bento Box Grid
en.description: A modular layout that places differently sized content cards on a shared grid. Each card groups one topic; the visual grouping does not imply that every card is interactive.
use_when: Several distinct product features or content groups need a shared overview.
Card size can express a meaningful information hierarchy.
avoid_when: Avoid fragmenting content that must be read in sequence.
Do not simply shrink a desktop grid on mobile; preserve reading order.
en.prompt_template:
Group content into topic cards on a shared column grid with consistent spacing. Let priority topics span columns, keep secondary topics compact, and stack cards in reading order on narrow screens. Distinguish interactive cards from informational ones.
Dedicated demonstration: Unequal topic blocks share a grid; a featured block spans rows, with information and action areas distinguished. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 粗野主义
zh-CN.description: 网页语境中的粗野主义常以直接、少装饰、暴露结构的视觉表达呈现内容。它与故意让人无法操作的反设计并不相同，也不同于建筑材料意义上的粗野主义。
use_when: 品牌表达适合直接的结构与文字。
内容本身比精细装饰更重要。
avoid_when: 不能把破坏导航与可访问性当作风格要求。
重要操作仍需要一致、可识别的入口。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用直接排版、简单表面和清楚的结构展示内容，弱化无关装饰；保留可读层级、可靠导航和一致链接样式；形式可以朴素，交互反馈和键盘操作不能缺失。
专属演示：直接的文档排版、实线分隔与原生可点击链接；切换章节展示真实导航。 参数：正文字号 {font_size_px}px。

en.name: Brutalism
en.description: In web design, brutalism often presents content through direct, minimally decorated and visibly structural composition. It is distinct from deliberately unusable antidesign and from the architectural meaning of the term.
use_when: The brand suits direct structure and typography.
Content matters more than decorative polish.
avoid_when: Do not treat broken navigation or accessibility as stylistic requirements.
Important actions still need consistent, recognizable entry points.
en.prompt_template:
Present content with direct typography, simple surfaces and clear structure while reducing unrelated decoration. Preserve readable hierarchy, dependable navigation and consistent links. The appearance can be raw, but feedback and keyboard interaction must remain usable.
Dedicated demonstration: Direct document typography, solid separators and operable links; section changes demonstrate real navigation. Parameters: body size {font_size_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 黏土拟态
zh-CN.description: 用圆润体积、柔和内外阴影与轻微高光营造黏土或软质塑形的外观。它是一种视觉处理，不能据此推断组件真的具有弹簧、拖拽或物理模拟。
use_when: 品牌或插图需要亲和的圆润体积感。
少量重点容器可以承受较多视觉细节。
avoid_when: 体积与陰影不应吞掉组件内部空间。
交互状态不能只靠材质高光细微变化。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在少量卡片与图形上使用圆润体积、柔和阴影和适度高光；正文与控制标签保持清楚对比；按下、选中和焦点状态独立可辨，不默认附加未经定义的弹性动画。
专属演示：圆润黏土球体与立体按钮，按压呈现内凹状态，不附加弹簧。 参数：圆角 {corner_px}px；投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px。

en.name: Claymorphism
en.description: A visual treatment suggesting clay or soft molded material through rounded volume, gentle inner and outer shadows and mild highlights. Appearance alone does not imply spring motion, dragging or physical simulation.
use_when: The brand or illustration benefits from friendly rounded volume.
A small number of highlighted surfaces can support richer visual detail.
avoid_when: Volume and shadows should not consume needed content space.
Interactive states must not rely solely on subtle highlight changes.
en.prompt_template:
Apply rounded volume, gentle shadows and moderate highlights to selected cards or graphics. Keep text and control labels clearly legible. Make pressed, selected and focused states independently recognizable without assuming unspecified elastic motion.
Dedicated demonstration: Rounded clay volumes and a dimensional button; pressing shows an inset state without a spring. Parameters: corner radius {corner_px}px; shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 点击涟漪
zh-CN.description: 从点击位置扩散并淡出，提供短暂的输入反馈。

en.name: Click Ripple
en.description: A wave expands and fades from the click point to acknowledge input.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Play a {duration_ms}ms expanding and fading ripple from the click point, clipped to the button. Start at the center for keyboard activation. Disable ripple for reduced motion.

zh-CN.name: 对比分析看板
zh-CN.description: 将不同时间、群组、方案或业务单元放在可比较的指标框架中。比较需要一致的单位、时间范围与统计口径，色彩不同不代表数据可直接相比。
use_when: 用户需要判断不同对象或时期之间的差异。
数据具有可解释的一致或可转换口径。
avoid_when: 不能使用不一致坐标范围误导比较。
不要忽略样本量或数据缺失造成的差异。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
并排展示可比较对象，统一单位、时间范围和图表尺度；突出差值与必要基准，说明样本量和口径差异；筛选变化后同步更新所有相关视图，并保留当前比较条件。
专属演示：同单位同尺度的两组并列条图与差值，切换比较对象更新对应样例。 参数：初始示例周期 {period}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Comparative Analysis Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard approach for comparing periods, cohorts, scenarios or business units within a consistent metric framework. Units, time windows and definitions must be comparable; different colors do not make unrelated data comparable.
use_when: Users need to assess differences between groups or periods.
The data has consistent or explicitly convertible definitions.
avoid_when: Avoid misleading comparisons with inconsistent axis scales.
Do not ignore differences caused by sample size or missing data.
en.prompt_template:
Show comparable entities side by side with consistent units, time ranges and scales. Highlight differences and relevant baselines, and explain sample sizes or definition changes. Update related views together after filtering and keep comparison conditions visible.
Dedicated demonstration: Two side-by-side bar series on the same units and scale, with differences; switch comparison groups to update samples. Parameters: initial sample period {period}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 对比度
zh-CN.description: 背景与前景的差异帮助文字和操作被辨认；颜色也不能是状态的唯一表达。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
检查文字、背景与交互边界的对比，为状态增加文字或图标辅助。常规正文以 WCAG AA 的 4.5:1 要求为检查目标，实际组合需测量。
专属演示：用真实前景色计算相对亮度与对比度，展示弱对比与测量后的文字样例。 参数：文字颜色 {text_color}。

en.name: Contrast
en.description: Differences between foreground and background support legibility; color must not be the only state cue.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Measure foreground/background contrast and supplement state colors with text or icons. Check normal text against the WCAG AA 4.5:1 requirement.
Dedicated demonstration: Compute relative luminance and contrast from the actual foreground color, comparing weak and measured text samples. Parameters: text color {text_color}.

zh-CN.name: 转化优化型
zh-CN.description: 围绕一个明确的转化目标组织信息、操作与反馈，例如完成注册或开始试用。是否优化有效需结合用户任务和实际数据验证，不能仅由按钮颜色或视觉风格判断。
use_when: 有明确且对用户有价值的主要行动。
能够验证关键步骤的完成率与阻碍。
avoid_when: 不要用误导、假倒计时或默认勾选迫使用户行动。
不要把停留时间或点击量直接当作完成目标。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
确定一个对用户有价值的主行动，按决策所需信息排列页面，清楚说明成本与限制；减少重复填写和无关选择；完成后给出明确反馈，并以真实任务完成数据评估改版。
专属演示：清楚成本说明与两步表单，真实本地校验、上一步和完成反馈。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Conversion-Optimized
en.description: A page approach organized around an explicit conversion goal such as registration or starting a trial. Its effectiveness requires evidence from user tasks and actual outcomes, not assumptions based on button color or visual style.
use_when: The primary action has a clear benefit for users.
The team can evaluate completion and obstacles along the task path.
avoid_when: Avoid deceptive urgency, fake countdowns and coercive defaults.
Do not treat time on page or raw clicks as task completion.
en.prompt_template:
Define one user-benefiting primary action and organize information around that decision. Explain costs and limitations, reduce duplicate entry and irrelevant choices, and give clear completion feedback. Evaluate changes using actual task outcomes.
Dedicated demonstration: Clear cost information and a two-step form with real local validation, back navigation and completion feedback. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 鼠标聚光
zh-CN.description: 光晕位置跟随指针，用局部亮度变化反馈鼠标所在位置。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 为卡片添加半径 {radius_px}px、颜色 {color}、透明度 {opacity} 的指针聚光，灯光跟随时间常数 {follow_ms}ms（0 直接跟随）；悬停抬升 {lift_px}px，抬升过渡 {duration_ms}ms。不拦截点击；触摸与减少动态效果时使用静态状态。

en.name: Cursor Spotlight
en.description: A pointer-tracked radial glow makes the hovered region visible.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Use a pointer-tracked radial glow with radius {radius_px}px, color {color}, opacity {opacity} and following time constant {follow_ms}ms (0 follows directly). Lift the card by {lift_px}px on hover over {duration_ms}ms. Do not intercept clicks. Use a static state on touch and reduced motion.

zh-CN.name: 自定义光标
zh-CN.description: 有明确形状的图形跟随鼠标，并与可调节的聚光、悬停和点击反馈组合。默认采用叶片、米色叶脉、朱砂墨点与暖杏金光晕；输入区、键盘和触摸保留原生操作。
use_when: 品牌介绍、作品集或轻量互动展示，需要让指针与页面视觉语言呼应。
先确认点击热区与图形尖端的位置，并提供明确的悬停和点击状态。
avoid_when: 密集表单、文本编辑或需要精确定位的任务，不应遮挡原生指针或文字选择。
触摸、键盘和减少动态效果时使用静态形状示意与原生指针。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 在演示区域使用形状为 {shape}、尺寸 {size_px}px、颜色 {color} 的自定义 SVG 光标。跟随平滑时间常数为 {follow_ms}ms（0 表示直接跟随）；可点击目标悬停时放大至 {hover_scale} 倍，点击反馈使用 {click_effect}，反馈与缩放过渡为 {duration_ms}ms。按形状热区定位，图形不拦截点击；离开区域、切换效果或按 Tab/Escape 时清理跟随与未完成反馈。文字输入、触摸及减少动态效果时保留原生指针，并显示静态形状示意。 聚光颜色为 {spotlight_color}，半径 {spotlight_radius_px}px、透明度 {spotlight_opacity}（0 关闭聚光），灯光跟随时间常数 {spotlight_follow_ms}ms。叶片形状保留米色叶脉与朱砂墨点。图形跟随与灯光跟随分别调节。

en.name: Custom Cursor
en.description: A shaped cursor combines with adjustable spotlight, hover and click feedback. The default leaf has a cream vein, vermilion accent and warm amber light. Input, keyboard and touch retain native behavior.
use_when: Brand pages, portfolios or lightweight interactive showcases where the pointer supports the visual identity.
Align the graphic hotspot with the click location and provide recognizable hover and click states.
avoid_when: Dense forms, text editing or precision tasks where a custom graphic obscures native pointer cues.
Use a static shape illustration and native pointer for touch, keyboard and reduced motion.
en.prompt_template: Within the demo area, use a custom SVG cursor with shape {shape}, size {size_px}px and color {color}. Use a following time constant of {follow_ms}ms (0 follows directly). Scale to {hover_scale} on clickable targets, with {click_effect} click feedback and {duration_ms}ms feedback/scale transitions. Align the shape hotspot; the graphic must not intercept clicks. Cancel tracking and unfinished feedback on exit, effect switch, Tab or Escape. Retain native input and pointer behavior with a static shape illustration for text input, touch and reduced motion. Spotlight color is {spotlight_color}, radius {spotlight_radius_px}px, opacity {spotlight_opacity} (0 disables the light), with a light-following time constant of {spotlight_follow_ms}ms. The leaf shape retains a cream vein and vermilion accent. Cursor following and light following are independent.

ja.name: カスタムカーソル
ja.description: 図形カーソルに調整可能な光、ホバー、クリック反応を組み合わせます。初期設定は葉形、クリーム色の葉脈、朱色の点と暖かい金色の光。入力・キーボード・タッチは標準操作を維持します。
use_when: ブランド紹介、ポートフォリオ、軽い体験型コンテンツで見た目を統一したい場合。
図形のホットスポットとクリック位置を合わせ、状態の変化を分かりやすくする場合。
avoid_when: 入力項目の多いフォーム、文章編集、精密な位置指定では標準ポインターを妨げない。
タッチや動きを減らす設定では、静止した図形と標準ポインターを使う。
ja.prompt_template: デモ領域で形状 {shape}、サイズ {size_px}px、色 {color} の SVG カーソルを使用。追従の時定数は {follow_ms}ms（0 は直接追従）、クリック可能な要素へのホバー倍率は {hover_scale}、クリック反応は {click_effect}、反応と拡縮は {duration_ms}ms。ホットスポットを合わせ、クリックを遮らない。領域外・効果切替・Tab/Escape で追従と未完了の反応を解除。文字入力・タッチ・動きを減らす設定では標準操作と静止した図形表示を保つ。 光の色は {spotlight_color}、半径 {spotlight_radius_px}px、不透明度 {spotlight_opacity}（0 は光を無効化）、追従の時定数は {spotlight_follow_ms}ms。葉の形状はクリーム色の葉脈と朱色の点を保持。カーソルと光の追従を別々に調整します。

ko.name: 사용자 지정 커서
ko.description: 모양 있는 커서를 조절 가능한 빛, 호버, 클릭 반응과 결합합니다. 기본값은 크림색 잎맥과 주홍색 점이 있는 나뭇잎과 따뜻한 금빛입니다. 입력, 키보드, 터치는 기본 동작을 유지합니다.
use_when: 브랜드 소개, 포트폴리오 또는 가벼운 인터랙션에서 시각적 분위기를 맞출 때.
그래픽의 핫스폿을 클릭 위치에 맞추고 호버와 클릭 상태를 명확히 구분할 때.
avoid_when: 복잡한 폼, 텍스트 편집 또는 정밀 작업에서 기본 포인터를 가리지 않도록 합니다.
터치 및 모션 감소 설정에서는 정적인 모양과 기본 포인터를 사용합니다.
ko.prompt_template: 데모 영역에서 모양 {shape}, 크기 {size_px}px, 색상 {color}의 SVG 커서를 사용합니다. 따라오기 시간 상수는 {follow_ms}ms(0은 즉시 이동), 클릭 가능한 요소의 호버 배율은 {hover_scale}, 클릭 피드백은 {click_effect}, 피드백 및 크기 전환 시간은 {duration_ms}ms입니다. 핫스폿을 맞추고 클릭을 가로채지 않습니다. 영역을 벗어나거나 효과 변경, Tab/Escape 시 추적과 진행 중인 피드백을 정리합니다. 텍스트 입력, 터치, 모션 감소 설정에는 기본 조작과 정적인 모양을 유지합니다. 빛 색상은 {spotlight_color}, 반경 {spotlight_radius_px}px, 불투명도 {spotlight_opacity} (0은 빛 끄기), 빛 따라오기 시간 상수는 {spotlight_follow_ms}ms입니다. 나뭇잎 모양은 크림색 잎맥과 주홍색 점을 유지합니다. 커서와 빛의 따라오기를 따로 조절합니다.

de.name: Benutzerdefinierter Cursor
de.description: Ein geformter Zeiger kombiniert anpassbares Licht, Hover und Klickfeedback. Standard ist ein Blatt mit cremefarbener Ader, zinnoberrotem Akzent und warmem Goldlicht. Eingabe, Tastatur und Touch bleiben nativ.
use_when: Markenseiten, Portfolios und leichte interaktive Präsentationen, bei denen der Zeiger zur Gestaltung passt.
Grafik-Hotspot und Klickposition ausrichten und verständliche Hover- und Klickzustände anbieten.
avoid_when: In dichten Formularen, Texteditoren und Präzisionsaufgaben native Zeigerhinweise nicht verdecken.
Bei Touch und reduzierter Bewegung eine statische Form und den nativen Zeiger verwenden.
de.prompt_template: Im Demobereich einen SVG-Cursor mit Form {shape}, Größe {size_px}px und Farbe {color} verwenden. Zeitkonstante des Nachlaufs: {follow_ms}ms (0 folgt direkt). Auf klickbaren Zielen auf {hover_scale} skalieren; Klickfeedback {click_effect}, Feedback- und Skalierungsdauer {duration_ms}ms. Hotspot ausrichten und Klicks nicht abfangen. Nachlauf und laufendes Feedback beim Verlassen, Effektwechsel, Tab oder Escape entfernen. Bei Texteingabe, Touch und reduzierter Bewegung native Bedienung und eine statische Form beibehalten. Lichtfarbe {spotlight_color}, Radius {spotlight_radius_px}px, Deckkraft {spotlight_opacity} (0 schaltet das Licht aus), Licht-Nachlaufzeitkonstante {spotlight_follow_ms}ms. Die Blattform behält eine cremefarbene Ader und einen zinnoberroten Akzent. Zeiger- und Lichtnachlauf werden getrennt eingestellt.

zh-CN.name: 赛博朋克 UI
zh-CN.description: 通过深色背景、霓虹强调、技术化图形与都市科幻意象表达赛博朋克氛围。它是主题化视觉，不要求闪烁、故障文字或持续 HUD 动画。
use_when: 娱乐、游戏或科技品牌有明确的主题表达。
少量霓虹强调可以帮助区分信息层级。
avoid_when: 高饱和光效不宜覆盖正文和密集数据。
不要用频繁闪烁表达重要状态。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
使用深色表面和有限霓虹强调，把科幻图形放在装饰层；正文、状态与主操作保持高可读性；重要变化用文字和稳定状态表达，故障与闪烁效果可关闭且不影响任务。
专属演示：深色技术面板、切角边界与霓虹强调；单次本地扫描更新明确状态，无闪烁循环。 参数：强调色 {accent}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Cyberpunk UI
en.description: A themed visual direction using dark backgrounds, neon accents, technical graphics and urban science-fiction imagery. It does not require flicker, glitch text or continuously animated HUD elements.
use_when: Entertainment, games or a technology brand has a clear thematic intent.
Selective neon accents can reinforce hierarchy.
avoid_when: Intense glow should not cover body text or dense data.
Do not use frequent flicker to communicate important states.
en.prompt_template:
Use dark surfaces with limited neon accents and keep science-fiction graphics in decorative layers. Preserve readable text, states and actions. Communicate important changes through text and stable cues; any glitch or flicker treatment must be optional and nonessential.
Dedicated demonstration: A dark technical panel, clipped edges and neon accents; one local scan updates an explicit status without flashing loops. Parameters: accent color {accent}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: OLED 深色模式
zh-CN.description: 以深色表面为基础的显示方案，可在支持的 OLED 屏幕上选择黑色或近黑色背景。OLED 指屏幕技术，不是一个保证省电或提高可读性的 UI 风格名称。
use_when: 用户偏好深色主题或在低亮度环境使用。
产品需要保持深浅主题的内容与状态一致。
avoid_when: 不要直接反转所有颜色或使用刺眼的满屏白字。
功耗与观感需要在实际设备上验证。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
建立深色背景、表面和文字的层级色阶；正文使用足够对比且不过亮的色值，主操作和错误状态仍可辨认；同时提供浅色主题，不把纯黑或省电视为硬性保证。
专属演示：在真实深浅主题之间切换，并保持前景、表面和状态层级；不宣称省电。 参数：初始主题 {theme}；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Dark Mode OLED
en.description: A dark-surface display direction that may use black or near-black backgrounds on OLED screens. OLED is display technology, not a UI style that guarantees energy savings or better readability.
use_when: Users prefer a dark theme or work in low-light environments.
The product needs consistent content and states across light and dark themes.
avoid_when: Do not simply invert every color or fill the screen with glaring white text.
Validate energy use and visual comfort on actual devices.
en.prompt_template:
Define separate dark background, surface and text levels. Keep body copy legible without excessive brightness, and preserve recognizable actions and errors. Offer a light theme as well; do not promise that pure black is always preferable or saves energy.
Dedicated demonstration: Switch real dark/light themes while preserving text, surface and status hierarchy; no energy-saving claim. Parameters: initial theme {theme}; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 高密度数据看板
zh-CN.description: 面向经常比较和定位细节的专业用户，在可读的基础上集中呈现较多指标、表格和筛选。高密度来自有效组织，不等于缩小所有字号或去掉间距。
use_when: 专业用户需要同时比较多项数据。
具有稳定的表格结构和明确筛选维度。
avoid_when: 新用户缺少指标解释时会难以理解。
不要牺牲文字可读性与可点击区域。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用稳定网格、紧凑但清楚的表格和分组标签增加有效密度；筛选条件保持可见，数字列对齐并标出单位；按任务提供详情展开或聚焦视图，不以小字号代替信息组织。
专属演示：可筛选的密集表格、单位与数字对齐；行高调整是真实布局变化。 参数：行高 {row_px}px。

en.name: Data-Dense Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard approach for expert users who compare and locate detailed information frequently. Density comes from effective organization of metrics, tables and filters, not from shrinking every label or eliminating spacing.
use_when: Expert users need to compare multiple data points simultaneously.
Stable tables and clear filtering dimensions support the task.
avoid_when: Unexplained metrics make the page difficult for new users.
Do not trade away legibility or usable interaction targets.
en.prompt_template:
Increase useful density with a stable grid, compact readable tables and grouped labels. Keep filters visible, align numeric columns and show units. Provide task-based detail or focus views instead of substituting tiny text for organization.
Dedicated demonstration: A filterable dense table with units and aligned numbers; row-height changes alter the actual layout. Parameters: row height {row_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 维度分层
zh-CN.description: 工作用布局标签：通过前后遮挡、表面色差、边界和必要的阴影表达内容的层级。视觉上前移的元素应对应真实的重要性或交互关系。
use_when: 需要区别主内容、浮层与辅助信息。
覆盖式交互需要清楚的前后关系。
avoid_when: 不必要的遮挡会隐藏内容与操作。
不要把每个元素都做成独立浮层。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
先按信息和交互关系确定表面层级，再用边界、底色和少量阴影表现前后；覆盖层不遮挡必要操作，关闭后恢复原位置的焦点；窄屏减少无意义叠放。
专属演示：后景信息层与前景详情层，打开、关闭和 Escape 展示遮挡与焦点恢复。 参数：层间位移 {depth_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Dimensional Layering
en.description: A working layout label for expressing depth through overlap, surface contrast, boundaries and selective shadows. Elements that appear closer should have a meaningful priority or interaction role.
use_when: Main content, overlays and supporting information need distinct roles.
Overlay interactions require a clear foreground and background relationship.
avoid_when: Unnecessary overlap hides content and actions.
Avoid turning every element into a separate floating layer.
en.prompt_template:
Define surface roles from information and interaction needs, then express depth with boundaries, surface colors and selective shadows. Keep required actions accessible, restore focus after overlays close, and reduce decorative overlap on narrow screens.
Dedicated demonstration: Background information and a foreground detail layer; open, close and Escape demonstrate layering and focus restoration. Parameters: layer depth {depth_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 下钻分析
zh-CN.description: 从汇总指标逐步进入细分数据，并保留维度与筛选上下文的分析交互。下钻通常沿分类或层级深入，不等于任何“点击查看详情”。
use_when: 用户需要定位汇总变化背后的群组或项目。
数据具有可解释的维度或层级。
avoid_when: 没有清楚维度时不要设计无限层级跳转。
不能在下钻后悄悄改变指标口径。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
从概览提供进入分组和明细的入口，保持时间范围、筛选与指标定义一致；用面包屑或当前维度说明位置；返回上层时恢复原视图和筛选，必要时区分下钻与独立详情。
专属演示：汇总到分组到明细的可点击层级，面包屑和返回恢复当前上下文。 参数：行高 {row_px}px。

en.name: Drill-Down Analytics
en.description: An analysis interaction that moves from aggregate metrics to more detailed dimensions while preserving filters and context. Drill-down usually follows a category hierarchy rather than meaning any generic details click.
use_when: Users need to identify groups or records behind aggregate changes.
The data has meaningful dimensions or hierarchy.
avoid_when: Avoid endless hierarchical navigation without meaningful dimensions.
Do not silently change metric definitions after drilling down.
en.prompt_template:
Provide routes from overview to grouped data and records, preserving time range, filters and metric definitions. Show the current dimension through breadcrumbs or context labels. Restore the prior view when returning, and distinguish drill-down from independent detail views.
Dedicated demonstration: Clickable summary, group and detail levels, with breadcrumbs and back navigation preserving context. Parameters: row height {row_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 缓动曲线
zh-CN.description: 缓动决定时间与进度的关系。它改变运动节奏，不等于改变持续时间。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
入场可考虑 ease-out，让开始较快、结束较慢；退出可考虑 ease-in。结合任务与距离观察效果，不把某条曲线当作高级设计的通用保证。
专属演示：两个实际运动对象以线性和所选缓动同步播放，行程与时长一致以便比较。 参数：选定缓动 {easing}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Easing
en.description: Easing maps elapsed time to animation progress. It changes pacing, not duration.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Consider ease-out for entrances and ease-in for exits. Evaluate the curve in context; no single easing curve guarantees a premium design.
Dedicated demonstration: Two real moving objects play linear and selected easing together with equal distance and duration. Parameters: selected easing {easing}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 夸张极简主义
zh-CN.description: 工作用风格标签：保留很少的内容，同时用超大标题、醒目比例或强烈留白制造冲击。强调的是视觉主次，不是删除用户完成任务所需的信息。
use_when: 首屏有一个需要突出表达的核心信息。
品牌主题适合以排印作为主要视觉。
avoid_when: 不适合依赖同时比较大量信息的界面。
长标题不能在手机上被截断或挤出按钮。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用一个大标题承载首屏主题，其余信息精简为必要说明和主操作；通过留白与比例形成张力；为长文案和窄屏降低字号或换行，保持正文可读。
专属演示：超大主题字与大留白围绕单一操作，窄屏保留必要说明。 参数：标题字号 {heading_px}px；内容内边距 {space_px}px。

en.name: Exaggerated Minimalism
en.description: A working style label for sparse content with oversized headings, striking proportions or pronounced whitespace. It emphasizes visual priority without removing information required to complete a task.
use_when: The opening screen has one central message to emphasize.
Typography can carry the main brand expression.
avoid_when: It is a poor fit for comparing many data points at once.
Long headings must not be clipped or crowd actions on mobile.
en.prompt_template:
Let one oversized heading carry the first-screen message, supported by essential copy and a primary action. Use whitespace and proportion for emphasis. Adapt type size and wrapping for long copy and narrow screens while keeping body text readable.
Dedicated demonstration: Oversized typography and generous whitespace around one action, retaining essential text on narrow screens. Parameters: heading size {heading_px}px; content padding {space_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 高管驾驶舱
zh-CN.description: 面向管理决策的看板组织方式：以少量关键指标、目标差距和需要关注的变化提供概览，再允许查看原因。它描述使用角色与决策任务，不是固定视觉皮肤。
use_when: 使用者需要快速判断总体状况和需要介入的事项。
指标定义、目标与更新节奏可明确说明。
avoid_when: 没有上下文的数字不支持可靠判断。
不要将过多运营细节全部塞进首屏。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
围绕决策目标选择少量核心指标，标出单位、时间范围、目标和变化；优先突出异常与待处理事项，提供进入详细分析的入口；说明数据更新时间与统计口径。
专属演示：少量 KPI、目标进度与关注事项，展开关键指标显示本地细分样例。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Executive Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard approach for management decisions: a concise view of key metrics, target gaps and notable changes with access to underlying reasons. It describes audience and decision tasks rather than a fixed visual skin.
use_when: Users need a quick assessment of overall status and issues requiring attention.
Metric definitions, targets and update cadence can be explained.
avoid_when: Context-free numbers do not support reliable decisions.
Do not crowd the overview with every operational detail.
en.prompt_template:
Select a small set of metrics for the decision at hand. Show units, time windows, targets and change, highlight notable issues, and offer a route to detailed analysis. Explain update time and metric definitions.
Dedicated demonstration: A few KPIs, target progress and attention items; expand a metric to inspect local sample detail. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 功能展示型
zh-CN.description: 工作用页面标签：按用户目标分组介绍产品功能，用场景、实例和清楚的层级支持比较。它并不是把所有功能堆成等权重的卡片墙。
use_when: 产品有多组能力，用户需要选择适合自己的场景。
功能之间有明确分组和差异。
avoid_when: 不要把路线图功能描述为已可使用。
全部等权展示会增加寻找关键能力的负担。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按用户任务分组介绍功能，先展示核心能力，再补充扩展能力；每组附一个具体使用例子与可验证状态；明确已支持、试验和计划中的功能，保留快速进入相关体验的入口。
专属演示：按用户任务分组的功能标签与关联演示区，切换标签实际改变内容。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Feature-Rich Showcase
en.description: A working page label for showcasing capabilities in groups tied to user goals, with scenarios, examples and hierarchy. It is not an instruction to give every feature equal prominence.
use_when: Users need to select among several capability groups.
Features have meaningful categories and differences.
avoid_when: Do not present roadmap items as currently available.
Equal emphasis on every feature makes priority capabilities harder to find.
en.prompt_template:
Group capabilities by user task, lead with the core ones and then cover extensions. Provide a concrete example and verifiable availability for each group. Distinguish supported, experimental and planned features, and offer a direct route to relevant experiences.
Dedicated demonstration: Task-grouped feature tabs and an associated demo area; selecting tabs changes the content. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 财务看板
zh-CN.description: 围绕收入、费用、现金流或其他财务指标组织的看板。它描述数据与工作任务，不代表投资建议；每个数字需要币种、时间范围和会计或业务口径。
use_when: 使用者需要比较财务指标或追踪预算差异。
数据口径、访问权限与时间范围能够明确。
avoid_when: 不能混合不同币种而不说明换算。
不应把未结算、预测或缺失数字伪装为实绩。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
围绕任务分组展示收入、支出和现金流，明确币种、周期、单位和口径；将预算、实绩与预测区分开，负值与异常除颜色外还有文字提示；保留数据来源与访问权限说明。
专属演示：样例收入、支出与结余的现金流分解，货币单位同步用于全部数字和图表。 参数：样例货币单位 {currency}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Financial Dashboard
en.description: A dashboard organized around financial measures such as revenue, expenses or cash flow. It describes data and work tasks rather than investment advice; values require currency, period and accounting or business definitions.
use_when: Users need to compare financial measures or track budget variance.
Definitions, permissions and reporting periods can be made explicit.
avoid_when: Do not combine currencies without explaining conversion.
Do not present unsettled, forecast or missing values as actual results.
en.prompt_template:
Group revenue, expenses and cash flow by the task, showing currency, period, units and definitions. Separate budgets, actual results and forecasts. Use textual cues as well as color for negative values and exceptions, and explain provenance and access permissions.
Dedicated demonstration: Sample income, expense and balance decomposition; the chosen currency applies to every number and chart. Parameters: sample currency {currency}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 扁平化设计
zh-CN.description: 主要依靠平面色块、排印、间距和形状传达层级，弱化模拟实体材质和立体装饰。扁平并不意味着按钮、链接与输入框可以失去可识别的交互提示。
use_when: 希望视觉结构简洁并适配多种屏幕。
图标与组件需要统一的形状语言。
avoid_when: 不要让按钮和普通文本无法区分。
不能只用颜色区分状态或操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用简洁色块、明确文字层级和统一间距组织页面；按钮保留形状、标签与可见状态，链接保留识别提示；减少装饰阴影，仍提供清楚的焦点和错误信息。
专属演示：无投影的平面色块、清楚的按钮轮廓与可切换选中状态。 参数：强调色 {accent}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Flat Design
en.description: A style that relies on flat color, typography, spacing and shape rather than realistic materials or heavy dimensional decoration. Interactive elements still require clear visual signifiers.
use_when: The interface needs a clean visual structure across screen sizes.
Icons and components need a consistent shape language.
avoid_when: Do not make buttons indistinguishable from ordinary text.
Do not rely solely on color to convey state or interactivity.
en.prompt_template:
Organize the page with simple color fields, clear text hierarchy and consistent spacing. Give buttons recognizable shapes, labels and states, and make links identifiable. Reduce decorative shadows while retaining clear focus and error feedback.
Dedicated demonstration: Shadow-free flat color blocks, distinct button outlines and a switchable selected state. Parameters: accent color {accent}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 玻璃拟态
zh-CN.description: 以半透明表面、背景模糊和细致边缘表现磨砂玻璃般的层次。实际内容的可读性取决于背景与表面的组合，不能只看单独一张浅色样稿。
use_when: 内容上方需要一层轻量浮动容器。
背景具备可辨识层次且文本仍有足够对比。
avoid_when: 密集表格或复杂背景容易使文字难读。
不支持模糊或减少透明效果时需要实色回退。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
为少量浮动卡片采用半透明底色、背景模糊与可见边界；文本使用稳定的高对比色，先检查复杂背景；提供不依赖模糊的实色替代，不把所有容器都做成玻璃。
专属演示：彩色背景透过真实 backdrop-filter 毛玻璃；关闭与恢复模糊可比较可读性。 参数：背景模糊 {blur_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Glassmorphism
en.description: A visual style using translucent surfaces, blurred backdrops and subtle edges to suggest frosted glass and layered depth. Legibility depends on the combined surface and background, not on an isolated mockup.
use_when: A lightweight floating surface is useful above background content.
Background depth can remain visible without weakening text contrast.
avoid_when: Dense tables and busy backgrounds can make translucent content difficult to read.
Provide an opaque fallback when blur or translucency is unavailable.
en.prompt_template:
Use translucency, backdrop blur and visible edges for a small number of floating cards. Keep text contrast stable across busy backgrounds and provide an opaque alternative that works without blur. Avoid applying glass treatment to every container.
Dedicated demonstration: Colored shapes behind a real backdrop-filter surface; toggle frosting to compare readability. Parameters: backdrop blur {blur_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.description: 用共享列线与间距统一页面结构，窄屏时重新组织列数。

en.description: Align elements using shared columns and gaps, and adapt column count on narrow screens.

Organize headings and cards on shared grid lines with consistent gaps. Use one column on narrow screens, avoid horizontal overflow, and preserve reading order.
Dedicated demonstration: A real CSS grid reflows content with column and gap controls, retaining reading order on narrow screens. Parameters: grid columns {columns}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 热力图风格
zh-CN.description: 用颜色编码矩阵、区域或空间中的数值差异，帮助发现集中、稀疏或异常位置。数据热力图与仅作装饰的热色渐变不同，必须提供图例、量纲与可访问的替代信息。
use_when: 需要观察两个维度交叉的数值分布。
空间位置或矩阵关系对任务有意义。
avoid_when: 不适合依靠颜色读取许多精确数值的任务。
不能让缺失数据和零值使用同一解释。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
根据真实数据建立明确色阶、图例与单位，标出行列维度和缺失数据；悬停、键盘或详情入口可读取数值；提供表格或文本替代，不用装饰渐变冒充数据图。
专属演示：带图例和数值的真实热力网格，点击或键盘聚焦单元格查看对应样例。 参数：强调色 {accent}；视觉强度 {intensity}。

en.name: Heat Map & Heatmap Style
en.description: A visualization that encodes values in a matrix or spatial region with color to expose concentrations, sparse areas or anomalies. A data heatmap differs from decorative warm gradients and needs a legend, units and accessible alternatives.
use_when: The task needs patterns across two intersecting dimensions.
Spatial or matrix relationships are meaningful.
avoid_when: Color alone is a poor way to read many exact values.
Do not conflate missing data with zero.
en.prompt_template:
Build the color scale, legend and units from actual data, label row and column dimensions, and distinguish missing values. Make exact values available through hover, keyboard or details, and provide table or text alternatives instead of using decorative gradients as data.
Dedicated demonstration: A real heatmap grid with legend and values; click or focus a cell to inspect its sample. Parameters: accent color {accent}; visual intensity {intensity}.

zh-CN.name: Hero 核心型
zh-CN.description: 以首屏 Hero 区域集中表达产品价值的页面组织方式，通常包含一个主要标题、简短说明、视觉证据与主行动入口。Hero 是内容优先级安排，不保证转化提升。
use_when: 新访客需要迅速理解产品面向谁、解决什么问题。
首屏有一个明确的下一步动作。
avoid_when: 主视觉不能把核心说明与按钮挤到不可见位置。
不要用空泛标语替代可核实的产品价值。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
首屏先说明产品对象和解决的问题，配一个可核实的界面或成果示例；突出一个主操作，次要链接降低视觉权重；移动端优先保留标题、价值说明和入口。
专属演示：大主题、简短价值说明与主操作配合独立主视觉；主操作改变本地体验状态。 参数：标题字号 {heading_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Hero-Centric Design
en.description: A page organization pattern that concentrates product value in the opening hero section through a main heading, concise explanation, supporting visual evidence and a primary action. It does not guarantee higher conversion.
use_when: New visitors need to understand the audience and product purpose quickly.
The opening screen has one clear next action.
avoid_when: Do not let imagery push essential explanation and actions out of view.
Avoid replacing verifiable value with vague slogans.
en.prompt_template:
State who the product is for and what problem it solves, supported by a verifiable interface or outcome example. Prioritize one action and give secondary links less weight. Keep the heading, value explanation and entry point prominent on mobile.
Dedicated demonstration: A dominant heading, concise value and primary action beside a dedicated hero visual; the action changes a local trial state. Parameters: heading size {heading_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 悬停抬升
zh-CN.description: 悬停时向上位移，离开后返回。用于提示可交互性，不改变布局占位。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 悬停时卡片向上移动 {lift_px}px，离开时回到原位，两次过渡均为 {duration_ms}ms。使用 ease-out，不改变布局。减少动态效果时关闭位移。

en.name: Hover Lift
en.description: Lift on hover and return on exit, without changing layout space.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Move the card up by {lift_px}px on hover and return on exit. Both transitions last {duration_ms}ms with ease-out, without changing layout. Disable movement for reduced motion.

zh-CN.name: 3D 与超写实
zh-CN.description: 用具有体积、材质、光照或细节的三维视觉表达对象与品牌氛围。3D 与超写实不是同义词；真实感程度需由任务决定，也不代表页面已经支持交互三维模型。
use_when: 对象的体积、结构或材质确实帮助理解。
品牌主视觉需要少量三维素材。
avoid_when: 不要用高成本三维装饰拖慢关键内容。
装饰模型不能暗示并不存在的产品能力。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
确认三维素材对任务的作用，按需要选择静态图或受控交互模型；正文与操作独立可用，提供文字或平面替代；控制资源体积和加载状态，不把写实效果当成功能证明。
专属演示：CSS 3D 物体与高光材质示意，调节姿态和光泽；不冒充照片级物理渲染。 参数：立体倾角 {tilt_deg}°；材质高光透明度 {shine}。 立体示意的 X 轴为 -{tilt_deg}°，Y 轴为固定 22°加{tilt_deg}°。

en.name: 3D & Hyperrealism
en.description: Using dimensional imagery with material, lighting or detail to express objects and brand atmosphere. 3D and hyperrealism are not synonymous, and realistic imagery does not imply an interactive 3D model is implemented.
use_when: Volume, structure or material helps explain the subject.
A small number of dimensional assets supports the brand.
avoid_when: Do not delay essential content with expensive decorative rendering.
Decorative models must not imply nonexistent product capabilities.
en.prompt_template:
Confirm what dimensional imagery adds to the task, then choose a static image or controlled interactive model as appropriate. Keep text and actions usable independently, provide text or flat alternatives, manage asset size and loading states, and avoid treating realism as proof of functionality.
Dedicated demonstration: A CSS 3D object and specular material study with pose and shine controls; not photorealistic physical rendering. Parameters: 3D tilt {tilt_deg}°; material highlight opacity {shine}. The CSS 3D pose uses X = -{tilt_deg} degrees and Y = 22 + {tilt_deg} degrees.

zh-CN.name: 包容性设计
zh-CN.description: 从被当前方案排除的人和情境出发，通过参与和替代路径减少不必要障碍。包容性设计比可访问性检查的范围更广，不能用一个假想“平均用户”代表所有人。
use_when: 能力、语言、设备、网络或情境差异会影响完成任务。
能让不同背景的用户参与设计与验证。
avoid_when: 不要靠人口标签推断所有人的需要。
不能用单一替代方式覆盖所有障碍。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
识别核心任务中谁被排除及其具体情境，邀请相关用户参与检查；为输入、阅读和恢复提供可选择路径；验证不同语言、辅助技术、设备和连接条件，不强迫所有人使用同一种交互。
专属演示：带文字的图标、输入替代路径与阅读偏好，模拟选择不排除键盘和触摸。 参数：正文字号 {font_size_px}px；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Inclusive Design
en.description: A design approach that starts with people and contexts excluded by the current solution and uses participation and alternatives to reduce barriers. Its scope extends beyond an accessibility checklist; one imagined average user cannot represent everyone.
use_when: Ability, language, device, connectivity or context affects task completion.
People with varied backgrounds can participate in design and evaluation.
avoid_when: Do not infer everyone’s needs from demographic labels alone.
One alternative cannot address every barrier.
en.prompt_template:
Identify who is excluded from core tasks and under what conditions, and involve those users in evaluation. Provide alternative paths for input, reading and recovery. Check languages, assistive technologies, devices and connection conditions without forcing one interaction method.
Dedicated demonstration: Labeled icons, an input alternative and reading preferences; simulated choices retain keyboard and touch access. Parameters: body size {font_size_px}px; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 信息架构
zh-CN.description: 用符合用户任务的分组、命名与层级组织内容，让人知道自己在哪里、下一步能去哪里。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按用户任务组织内容，提供清晰分类、当前位置与可预测导航；在信息量较大时提供搜索与目录等多种查找方式。
专属演示：真实分组导航、层级目录与路径，进入分类和返回更新同一内容区。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Information Architecture
en.description: Organize content with task-based labels, groups, and hierarchy so users know where they are and where to go.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template:
Organize content by user tasks with clear categories, location cues, and predictable navigation. For larger collections, provide multiple ways to find content, such as search and a directory.
Dedicated demonstration: Grouped navigation, a hierarchy and a path; entering and returning changes the same content area. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 行内校验
zh-CN.description: 在用户离开输入框或提交后，把明确错误与对应字段关联。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 邮箱字段在离焦时检查格式，错误说明与字段关联，不把空白的初始输入立即标成错误。更正后清除错误。

en.name: Inline Validation
en.description: Associate clear validation feedback with the field on blur or submission.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Validate email format on blur. Associate errors with the field, do not flag an untouched empty field immediately, and clear the error after correction.

zh-CN.name: 交互演示型
zh-CN.description: 让用户在受控样例中操作产品核心流程，而不只观看截图。演示需要标明模拟数据、实际支持范围和是否保存结果，不应暗示它已经完成真实业务操作。
use_when: 产品价值需要通过一次真实交互才能理解。
可提供无需敏感信息的代表性样例。
avoid_when: 演示不能默默发起付费或外部写入。
不能将假数据与真实业务结果混在一起。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
提供一个短小的可操作样例，突出输入、操作和反馈；明确哪些数据是模拟的、是否保存和哪些功能尚未实现；提供重置入口，让用户能重复比较结果。
专属演示：落地页内嵌可操作卡片：悬停抬升和点击确认共同支持先试后理解。 参数：悬停抬升 {lift_px}px；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Interactive Product Demo
en.description: Letting users operate a core product flow in a controlled example rather than only viewing screenshots. A demo should disclose simulated data, supported scope and persistence instead of implying real business actions occurred.
use_when: One interaction communicates value better than a static image.
A representative example can run without sensitive information.
avoid_when: Do not silently trigger paid services or external writes.
Do not mix simulated data with real business results.
en.prompt_template:
Provide a concise interactive example with visible input, action and feedback. Explain which data is simulated, whether results persist, and which capabilities are unavailable. Include reset so users can repeat and compare outcomes.
Dedicated demonstration: An interactive card embedded in a landing-page composition: hover lift and click confirmation enable trying before reading. Parameters: hover lift {lift_px}px; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 动态字体
zh-CN.description: 通过文字的位置、比例、节奏或出现顺序传递强调与叙事的动态排印。它描述文字的运动编排，不等于使用某种特殊字体或让所有正文一直移动。
use_when: 短标题或关键短语需要额外强调。
运动与文字内容有清楚关系。
avoid_when: 正文、表单标签和关键说明不应持续移动。
不能只在短暂动画的一帧展示必要内容。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
为短标题设计可读的文字入场或强调，完成后停在稳定排版；保留完整静态文本、阅读顺序和换行规则；减少动态效果时直接显示最终文字，不用视觉拆字破坏文本语义。
专属演示：真实文字逐字位移入场，字形使用同一字体体系；重播与减少动态效果清理正确。 参数：每字入场时长 {duration_ms}ms；逐字间隔 {delay_ms}ms；标题字号 {heading_px}px。

en.name: Kinetic Typography
en.description: Animated typography that communicates emphasis or narrative through position, scale, timing or reveal order. It describes choreographed text movement, not a special typeface or continuously moving body copy.
use_when: Short headings or key phrases benefit from added emphasis.
The motion has a clear relationship to the text.
avoid_when: Body copy, form labels and essential instructions should not keep moving.
Required information must not exist only for one brief animation frame.
en.prompt_template:
Animate the entry or emphasis of short headings, then settle into a stable readable layout. Preserve complete static text, reading order and wrapping. Show final text immediately when motion is reduced, and avoid breaking text semantics for visual letter effects.
Dedicated demonstration: Real text enters letter by letter using the same typography system; replay and reduced-motion cleanup are supported. Parameters: per-letter duration {duration_ms}ms; letter delay {delay_ms}ms; heading size {heading_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 液态玻璃
zh-CN.description: Apple 提出的动态界面材质，结合透明、光学变化和流动感，用于建立控件与内容的层级。网页中的模糊透明卡片只是近似视觉，不能默认声称等同于平台原生材质。
use_when: 目标平台确实支持相应原生材质与组件。
需要表达轻量悬浮控件与内容之间的层级。
avoid_when: 网页近似不能宣称已经还原原生光学行为。
密集内容与变化背景下必须检查可读性。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
先确认目标平台与可用材质；支持原生能力时采用对应平台组件，网页方案明确标注视觉近似；限定透明材质的使用范围，保证文字、状态和操作边界可辨，提供减少透明与动态效果的替代。
专属演示：透明透镜跟随指针展示高光、模糊和背景色彩变化；为 Web 材质近似，不是 Apple 原生渲染。 参数：背景模糊 {blur_px}px；玻璃高光透明度 {glass_strength}。

en.name: Liquid Glass
en.description: Apple’s dynamic interface material combining transparency, optical behavior and fluidity to establish hierarchy between controls and content. A blurred translucent web card is only an approximation, not automatically the native platform material.
use_when: The target platform supports the relevant native materials and components.
The design needs a lightweight hierarchy between controls and content.
avoid_when: Do not claim native optical behavior for a web approximation.
Check legibility over busy content and changing backgrounds.
en.prompt_template:
Confirm the target platform and available material first. Use the corresponding platform components where supported and label web treatments as visual approximations. Limit translucent surfaces, preserve readable text and state boundaries, and provide reduced-transparency and reduced-motion alternatives.
Dedicated demonstration: A pointer-tracked translucent lens shows highlights, blur and background color changes; a Web material approximation, not Apple native rendering. Parameters: backdrop blur {blur_px}px; glass highlight opacity {glass_strength}.

zh-CN.name: 孟菲斯设计
zh-CN.description: 以鲜明几何图形、图案、色彩碰撞和有意的非对称构图形成活泼视觉。作为 UI 方向时，装饰层与功能层需要分开，图形不自动成为操作按钮。
use_when: 活动或品牌表达需要活泼的图形性格。
正文较少，可以为装饰预留空间。
avoid_when: 密集业务界面不宜铺满高强度图案。
可操作元素不能与装饰图形混淆。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在主视觉与分区边缘使用少量几何图案和明确色彩对比；正文放在安静的表面上，操作组件保持统一形状与标签；控制图案数量，窄屏减少不必要装饰。
专属演示：圆点、锯齿与不规则几何构成，切换图形组合，正文独立保持可读。 参数：强调色 {accent}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Memphis Design
en.description: A visual direction using bold geometry, patterns, contrasting colors and deliberate asymmetry. In interfaces, decoration and functional controls need distinct roles; graphic motifs do not automatically become buttons.
use_when: A campaign or brand benefits from playful graphic expression.
Limited copy leaves room for decorative composition.
avoid_when: Avoid filling dense work interfaces with intense patterns.
Do not make controls indistinguishable from decorative shapes.
en.prompt_template:
Use selective geometric patterns and clear color contrast in key visuals and section edges. Put body text on quiet surfaces and give controls consistent shapes and labels. Limit competing patterns and reduce unnecessary decoration on narrow screens.
Dedicated demonstration: Dots, zigzags and irregular geometry; switch the arrangement while keeping text readable. Parameters: accent color {accent}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 微交互
zh-CN.description: 由一个具体触发与针对性反馈组成的小范围交互，例如按钮按压状态、保存结果或输入校验。微交互可以使用文字、状态或动效，不等于所有装饰动画。
use_when: 用户需要确认输入或操作已被识别。
状态变化需要在发生位置附近清楚表达。
avoid_when: 不要让反馈拖延真实操作或掩盖失败。
不要把系统尚未完成的工作提示为成功。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
为具体触发设计明确反馈，区分已接收、处理中、成功与失败；反馈靠近操作位置，兼顾键盘与触摸；动效可以减少或关闭，重要状态仍通过文字或形状保留。
专属演示：收藏操作的触发、选中规则、视觉反馈与状态文本完整演示，可反向取消。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Micro-interactions
en.description: A small interaction pairing a specific trigger with focused feedback, such as a pressed state, save result or input validation. Microinteractions may use text, state changes or motion; not every decorative animation qualifies.
use_when: Users need confirmation that input or an action was recognized.
A state change needs clear feedback near its context.
avoid_when: Feedback must not delay real work or hide failure.
Do not report success before the actual operation completes.
en.prompt_template:
Provide focused feedback for a specific trigger, distinguishing receipt, processing, success and failure. Keep feedback near its action and support keyboard and touch. Allow motion reduction while retaining important states through text or shape.
Dedicated demonstration: A complete favorite micro-interaction: trigger, selected-state rule, visual feedback and status text, with reversal. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 极简直给型
zh-CN.description: 工作用页面标签：尽早展示用途、必要信息与主操作，减少绕路和装饰。它描述任务路径的直接程度，不等于所有产品都只需要一屏。
use_when: 用户已知道要做什么，希望快速进入操作。
页面只有一个主要任务与少量决策信息。
avoid_when: 复杂产品需要的说明不能被删掉。
不要隐藏价格、权限需求或重要限制。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
开头直接说明用途与主操作，围绕用户下一步补充必要说明；移除重复入口和无关装饰；把价格、权限和限制放在决定发生之前。
专属演示：一句价值说明、单个输入与主按钮；提交显示本地完成状态。 参数：内容内边距 {space_px}px。

en.name: Minimal & Direct
en.description: A working page label for presenting purpose, essential information and the main action early. It describes a direct task path, not a requirement that every product fit on one screen.
use_when: Users already know their task and want to reach it quickly.
The page has one primary task with limited decision information.
avoid_when: Do not remove explanations that a complex product needs.
Do not hide pricing, permission requirements or important limitations.
en.prompt_template:
State the purpose and main action at the beginning, then provide the information needed for the next decision. Remove duplicate entry points and unrelated decoration. Show pricing, permissions and limitations before commitment.
Dedicated demonstration: One value statement, one input and one primary button; submission shows a local completion state. Parameters: content padding {space_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 极简与瑞士风格
zh-CN.description: 组合检索标签：极简强调减少无关元素，瑞士风格强调清晰栅格、无衬线排印与信息秩序。两者可以结合，但不属于同一个定义完全相同的流派。
use_when: 文本和信息层级比装饰更重要。
需要建立一致的排版与对齐关系。
avoid_when: 不要把极简变成隐藏重要操作或帮助。
品牌需要丰富叙事时，可保留必要的图像与情绪。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
删去重复装饰，按明确栅格对齐标题、正文与操作；用字体大小、字重和留白区分层级，保留可见的操作提示；不要用极低对比度表达克制。
专属演示：左对齐栅格、非对称留白与明确字阶，展示版式组织而非同一张通用卡。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px；标题字号 {heading_px}px。

en.name: Minimalism & Swiss Style
en.description: A combined search label: minimalism removes nonessential elements, while Swiss style emphasizes structured grids, clear typography and visual order. They can work together but are not identical design traditions.
use_when: Typography and information hierarchy matter more than decoration.
The product needs a consistent alignment and spacing system.
avoid_when: Do not hide essential actions or help in the name of minimalism.
Retain meaningful imagery when the brand needs a richer narrative.
en.prompt_template:
Remove redundant decoration and align headings, body text and actions to a clear grid. Use type size, weight and whitespace for hierarchy, retain visible interaction cues, and keep restrained styling legible.
Dedicated demonstration: An aligned grid, asymmetric whitespace and deliberate type hierarchy demonstrate the layout. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px; heading size {heading_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 动效驱动
zh-CN.description: 工作用交互方向：借助有目的的移动、出现和状态过渡表达关系、层级与操作结果。动效应服务任务，不能替代结构、说明或真实状态。
use_when: 静态变化难以表达前后状态或空间关系。
短暂过渡能帮助用户理解操作结果。
avoid_when: 不要强制等待装饰动画后才能继续任务。
持续装饰不能与反馈动效争夺注意力。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
先定义状态关系，再为切换、进入和反馈选择必要动效；允许中断和重复操作，旧动效在状态改变时清理；减少动态效果时用直接状态切换保留同样的信息。
专属演示：切换步骤驱动方向明确的内容过渡，不以持续装饰动画代替任务反馈。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms；过渡位移 {distance_px}px。

en.name: Motion-Driven
en.description: A working interaction direction that uses purposeful movement, appearance and transitions to express relationships, hierarchy and outcomes. Motion must serve the task rather than replace structure, explanation or real state.
use_when: A static change does not clearly convey state or spatial relationships.
A brief transition can help users understand an outcome.
avoid_when: Do not force users to wait for decoration before continuing a task.
Continuous decoration should not compete with meaningful feedback.
en.prompt_template:
Define state relationships first, then choose necessary motion for transitions, entry and feedback. Allow interruption and repeated actions, clean up obsolete motion when state changes, and preserve information through direct state changes when motion is reduced.
Dedicated demonstration: Step changes drive directional content transitions instead of continuous decoration replacing task feedback. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms; transition distance {distance_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 新粗野主义
zh-CN.description: 在界面中使用鲜明描边、硬边阴影、直接的排版和明显色块来突出结构。它通常比传统网页粗野主义更受控，但醒目的外观不能替代清楚的操作层级。
use_when: 品牌需要直接、鲜明且易识别的视觉性格。
少量关键操作需要强烈的可见边界。
avoid_when: 所有元素都同样抢眼会破坏层级。
不要用错位与密集描边牺牲文本和触控空间。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
采用清晰粗描边、少量高对比色块和硬边阴影；优先突出主操作，正文保持安静易读；组件间距和焦点提示一致，阴影不遮挡相邻内容。
专属演示：粗描边、实体偏移投影与色块，按下时投影收拢并显示本地反馈。 参数：描边 {border_px}px；投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px。

en.name: Neubrutalism
en.description: An interface style using bold outlines, hard shadows, direct typography and distinct color blocks. It is often more deliberately composed than web brutalism; visual boldness still needs clear interaction hierarchy.
use_when: The brand benefits from a direct and distinctive visual character.
A few key actions need highly visible boundaries.
avoid_when: Making every element equally loud destroys hierarchy.
Do not sacrifice legibility or touch space for offset shadows and dense outlines.
en.prompt_template:
Use clear bold outlines, a limited set of contrasting color blocks and hard shadows. Give the primary action priority while keeping body content quiet and readable. Maintain consistent spacing and focus cues; shadows must not obscure adjacent content.
Dedicated demonstration: Thick outlines, hard offset shadows and color blocks; pressing contracts the shadow and displays local feedback. Parameters: border width {border_px}px; shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 新拟态
zh-CN.description: 让组件与背景接近同一色系，通过相对的明暗阴影形成凸起或凹入的浮雕感。低对比边界容易使组件难以辨认，因此状态与可操作性需要额外提示。
use_when: 需要少量安静的浮雕式视觉强调。
有空间增加清楚的标签、边界与状态提示。
avoid_when: 密集表单与重要操作不应依赖低对比浮雕。
不要把装饰凸起自动等同于可点击。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
仅在少量表面使用同色系浮雕和相对的明暗阴影；按钮、输入框和选中状态补充清楚边界与标签；验证多种背景和显示条件，焦点与错误提示不依赖阴影。
专属演示：同色表面凸起与凹入对比，切换真实 aria-pressed 控件的内外阴影。 参数：投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Neumorphism
en.description: A style that uses closely matched component and background colors with paired light and dark shadows to suggest raised or inset relief. Low-contrast boundaries can make controls hard to identify, so states and interactivity need additional cues.
use_when: Selective quiet relief supports the visual direction.
Clear labels, boundaries and states can accompany the treatment.
avoid_when: Dense forms and critical actions should not depend on low-contrast relief.
Do not equate decorative elevation with clickability.
en.prompt_template:
Use closely matched surfaces and opposing light-dark shadows selectively. Give buttons, fields and selected states clear boundaries and labels. Check varied backgrounds and viewing conditions; focus and error cues must not depend on shadows.
Dedicated demonstration: Raised and inset same-color surfaces; a real aria-pressed control switches inner and outer shadows. Parameters: shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 有机亲自然
zh-CN.description: 工作用视觉标签：用自然意象、非机械轮廓和温和材质表达亲自然感。它不是健康效果保证，也不要求给每个组件添加叶子、波浪或随机圆角。
use_when: 品牌主题与自然、生活或温和触感相关。
装饰能辅助情绪而不遮挡任务信息。
avoid_when: 不规则形状不应损害对齐与可点击范围。
不要声称绿色与自然素材自动改善用户健康。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
选用自然相关的色彩与适量素材，在装饰区域采用有机轮廓；功能组件仍保持稳定栅格、明确边界与文字对比；纹理轻量化，避免影响正文阅读和页面性能。
专属演示：自然叶片、曲线分区与生长进度，支持本地照料状态切换。 参数：圆角 {corner_px}px；内容间距 {gap_px}px；强调色 {accent}。

en.name: Organic Biophilic
en.description: A working visual label for nature-related imagery, less mechanical contours and gentle material cues. It does not guarantee health benefits or require leaves, waves and random rounded shapes on every component.
use_when: The brand relates to nature, daily life or a gentle tactile tone.
Decoration supports mood without obscuring task information.
avoid_when: Irregular shapes must not undermine alignment or usable targets.
Do not claim that green colors or natural motifs automatically improve health.
en.prompt_template:
Use nature-related colors and selective imagery, with organic contours in decorative areas. Keep functional components on a stable grid with clear boundaries and readable contrast. Use lightweight textures that do not impair reading or page performance.
Dedicated demonstration: Organic leaves, curved sections and a growth meter with a local care-state toggle. Parameters: corner radius {corner_px}px; content gap {gap_px}px; accent color {accent}.

zh-CN.name: 视差叙事
zh-CN.description: 随滚动让前景与背景以不同幅度移动，以空间层次辅助内容叙事。它不应改变正常滚动的控制权，内容顺序与静态版本必须仍可理解。
use_when: 长页内容具有适合层次表达的叙事段落。
可提供完整静态阅读方案。
avoid_when: 不要劫持滚动或改变浏览器正常导航习惯。
对运动敏感的用户需要关闭非必要位移。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
保持浏览器原生滚动，只在装饰层使用适度前后景位移；正文与主操作保持稳定；限制层数与运动范围，提供静态或减少动态效果版本，所有内容按正常顺序可访问。
专属演示：可滚动叙事区内三层山景按不同距离移动，键盘滚动与章节按钮同样可用。 参数：层间位移 {depth_px}px。

en.name: Parallax Storytelling
en.description: Using different scroll-relative movement for foreground and background to support a narrative through depth. It should not take control of scrolling; the content order and static version must remain understandable.
use_when: A long page has narrative sections that benefit from depth cues.
A complete static reading alternative is available.
avoid_when: Avoid scroll hijacking and changes to normal browser navigation.
Motion-sensitive users need a way to disable nonessential movement.
en.prompt_template:
Keep native browser scrolling and use restrained foreground-background movement only in decorative layers. Keep copy and primary actions stable, limit layers and motion range, provide static or reduced-motion alternatives, and preserve normal access to all content.
Dedicated demonstration: Three landscape layers move by different distances inside a scrollable narrative, with keyboard scrolling and chapter buttons. Parameters: layer depth {depth_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 预测分析
zh-CN.description: 利用模型或规则估计未来结果、可能区间或风险的分析方式。预测是带假设与不确定性的输出，需要与历史实测数据区分，不是具有保证效果的视觉风格。
use_when: 用户确实需要评估未来可能情况。
有可说明的数据依据、假设与验证范围。
avoid_when: 没有实际模型时，不要把延长曲线称为可靠预测。
不要隐藏误差、假设或不适用情况。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
将历史实测与预测区域清楚分开，标出预测窗口、区间、更新时间与主要假设；提供查看依据和调整情景的入口；模型不可用或数据不足时明确显示状态，避免把估计写成事实。
专属演示：历史实线、预测虚线和区间带明确分隔；调节模拟预测跨度，不宣称真实预测能力。 参数：模拟预测跨度 {horizon_days}天。

en.name: Predictive Analytics
en.description: An analysis approach that estimates future outcomes, ranges or risks using models or rules. Predictions depend on assumptions and uncertainty and must be distinguished from observed data; this is not a visual style or a guaranteed outcome.
use_when: Users need to assess plausible future conditions.
Data provenance, assumptions and validation scope can be explained.
avoid_when: Without an actual model, do not present an extended curve as a reliable forecast.
Do not hide uncertainty, assumptions or unsuitable conditions.
en.prompt_template:
Separate observed history from the forecast region. Label the forecast horizon, ranges, update time and key assumptions. Offer access to the basis and scenario controls, and clearly show model unavailability or insufficient data instead of presenting estimates as facts.
Dedicated demonstration: Historical solid lines, a forecast dashed line and an interval band are separated; tune a synthetic horizon without claiming real prediction. Parameters: synthetic horizon {horizon_days} days.

zh-CN.description: 先显示完成任务所需的主要信息，再允许用户主动展开次要信息。

zh-CN.name: 实时监控
zh-CN.description: 持续或定期更新状态与事件的监控界面。所谓实时必须由实际刷新机制、时间戳和数据链路支持；仅有跳动数字或闪烁装饰并不代表实时数据。
use_when: 任务需要及时发现状态变化或异常。
数据来源可提供明确的更新与失效信息。
avoid_when: 不能把模拟或过期数据标为实时。
频繁刷新不应打断阅读、筛选或键盘操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
展示状态、最近更新时间和数据连接情况；新事件按优先级提示，过期或断连时明确标注；保留用户当前筛选与阅读位置，提供暂停自动更新或查看事件历史的方式。
专属演示：明确标注模拟数据的监控线图；手动步进或启动本地定时更新，离开时清理。 参数：本地更新间隔 {interval_ms}ms。

en.name: Real-Time Monitoring
en.description: A monitoring interface that updates states and events continuously or at defined intervals. Real-time claims require actual refresh behavior, timestamps and data delivery; animated numbers alone do not establish live data.
use_when: The task requires timely awareness of changes or anomalies.
The data source can communicate update and stale-state information.
avoid_when: Do not label simulated or stale data as live.
Frequent updates must not disrupt reading, filters or keyboard interaction.
en.prompt_template:
Show state, last update time and connection health. Prioritize new events and clearly mark stale data or disconnection. Preserve filters and reading position, and offer a way to pause updates or review event history.
Dedicated demonstration: A monitoring line chart labeled as synthetic data; step manually or start local timed updates, cleaned up on exit. Parameters: local update interval {interval_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 识别优于回忆
zh-CN.description: 在当前任务位置展示可识别的选项，减少用户记住术语、路径或前一步信息的负担。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在使用位置展示清晰标签与候选，保持导航位置和命名一致，不要求用户先记住上一页的信息才能继续。

en.description: Expose recognizable options where needed, reducing the need to remember terms or paths.

avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.

Dedicated demonstration: Visible suggestions and the current selection support recognition; selecting one fills a local search input. Parameters: visible suggestion count {suggestions}.

en.name: Reduced Motion

avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.

zh-CN.name: 复古未来主义
zh-CN.description: 借用过去对未来的视觉想象，例如复古仪表、几何轮廓或金属意象，再结合当前的界面任务。它没有唯一固定的年代、配色或实现库。
use_when: 产品叙事与技术想象或怀旧主题有关。
可用少量素材表达明确视觉方向。
avoid_when: 装饰仪表不应冒充真实数据或控制状态。
不要复制老系统的低可读性与隐蔽操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
选择一致的复古未来意象用于主视觉和辅助装饰；现代任务使用明确标签、可靠反馈和清楚导航；区分装饰仪表与真实指标，让窄屏保留必要功能而减少装饰。
专属演示：模拟仪表盘、同心轨道与模拟旋钮，切换频段改变读数而不调用设备。 参数：强调色 {accent}；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Retro-Futurism
en.description: A visual direction drawing on past visions of the future, such as retro instruments, geometric silhouettes or metallic imagery, while serving current interface tasks. It has no single required era, palette or implementation library.
use_when: The product story relates to technology imagination or nostalgia.
A selective set of motifs can express the visual direction.
avoid_when: Decorative instruments must not imply real data or control states.
Do not reproduce poor legibility or hidden controls from old systems.
en.prompt_template:
Use a coherent retro-futuristic motif set in key visuals and supporting decoration. Keep present-day tasks clearly labeled with dependable feedback and navigation. Distinguish decorative instruments from real metrics and reduce decoration on narrow screens.
Dedicated demonstration: Analog instruments, concentric orbits and a simulated dial; changing bands updates the reading without device access. Parameters: accent color {accent}; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 销售智能看板
zh-CN.description: 将销售阶段、客户机会、目标和行动线索组织成可操作概览。智能来自真实的数据与分析能力，而不是在普通销售表格上贴“AI”标签。
use_when: 团队需要判断机会进展并安排下一步跟进。
销售阶段、负责人和统计口径已清楚定义。

en.name: Sales Intelligence Dashboard
en.description: An actionable overview of sales stages, opportunities, targets and follow-up signals. Intelligence requires actual data and analysis capabilities, not an AI label added to an ordinary sales table.

Limit sensitive customer information to task and access needs.

Organize opportunities by sales stage and owner, highlighting follow-up needs and target gaps. Explain score basis and update time, separate predictions from facts, provide access to opportunity details, and respect customer-data permissions.

zh-CN.name: 拟物化
zh-CN.description: 通过熟悉的实体材质、形状或操作隐喻帮助理解数字界面，例如翻页或旋钮的视觉暗示。相似外观不保证用户懂得功能，隐喻应符合实际操作。
use_when: 实体工具的形状确实能帮助理解对应操作。
产品需要少量可识别的材质与空间暗示。
avoid_when: 不熟悉实体原型的用户可能无法理解隐喻。
装饰细节不能遮挡状态与必要标签。

只在能辅助理解的组件上采用实体形状或材质隐喻；配合明确文字标签与真实状态反馈；避免让装饰细节压过任务信息，为不熟悉隐喻的用户提供直接说明。
专属演示：纸页、缝线与装订细节构成实体手册，标签切换展示不同笔记。 参数：圆角 {corner_px}px；投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px。

en.name: Skeuomorphism
en.description: Using recognizable physical materials, shapes or interaction metaphors to help people interpret digital interfaces. Familiar appearance does not guarantee understanding; the metaphor should match actual behavior.
use_when: A physical tool metaphor helps explain the corresponding action.
Selective material or spatial cues support recognition.
avoid_when: People unfamiliar with the physical original may not understand the metaphor.
Decorative detail must not obscure states or necessary labels.
en.prompt_template:
Use physical shapes or material metaphors only where they aid understanding. Pair them with explicit labels and real state feedback. Keep decoration subordinate to task information and offer direct explanations for people unfamiliar with the metaphor.
Dedicated demonstration: Paper, stitching and binding form a physical notebook metaphor; tabs switch between notes. Parameters: corner radius {corner_px}px; shadow offset/spread {shadow_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 社会证明型
zh-CN.description: 用真实评价、案例、使用者或可核实的数据帮助用户判断产品是否适合自己。社会证明是说服信息，不是可替代产品说明、真实证据或安全保证的装饰。
use_when: 新用户希望了解他人的实际使用经历。
评价的对象和场景与目标用户相关。
avoid_when: 不能伪造评价、品牌合作或使用人数。
不相关的名人背书不能替代实用信息。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在相关决策信息附近展示可核实的用户评价或案例，说明场景、来源和必要日期；优先用具体成果与限制，避免无出处数字；外部引用取得许可并提供访问来源的入口。
专属演示：明确标为虚构的样例反馈卡与角色来源，切换角色展示不同使用情境。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Social Proof-Focused
en.description: Using authentic reviews, case studies, customer evidence or verifiable usage data to support a decision. Social proof is persuasive information, not a substitute for product explanation, evidence or safety guarantees.
use_when: New users want evidence of other people’s actual experiences.
The evidence matches the intended audience and use case.
avoid_when: Never fabricate testimonials, partnerships or user counts.
Unrelated celebrity endorsement does not replace useful evidence.
en.prompt_template:
Place verifiable testimonials or cases near the decision they support. Include context, attribution and dates where relevant. Prefer concrete outcomes and limitations over unsourced numbers, obtain required permissions, and provide a route to the source.
Dedicated demonstration: Explicitly fictional sample testimonials and attributed roles; switch roles to compare usage contexts. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 柔和 UI 进化版
zh-CN.description: 工作用标签：保留柔和表面、圆润形状与轻微浮雕感，同时用更清楚的边界、文字和状态改善新拟态的识别问题。不是具有统一规范的独立设计体系。

希望减少硬边装饰而保留组件边界。
avoid_when: 不能依赖两道淡阴影作为唯一交互提示。
不要声称柔和外观自动满足无障碍。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
保留柔和表面与适度圆角；为按钮、输入框和选中状态设置可辨识的边界和对比；轻微阴影只表达辅助层次，键盘焦点与错误提示独立可见。
专属演示：柔和表面保留清楚边界和文字对比，真实选择控件显示选中与焦点状态。 参数：投影偏移/扩散 {shadow_px}px；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Soft UI Evolution
en.description: A working label for soft surfaces, rounded shapes and subtle relief with clearer boundaries, typography and state cues than low-contrast neumorphism. It is not a separate standardized design system.

Components need visible boundaries without heavy decorative edges.
avoid_when: Do not use faint paired shadows as the only interaction cue.
A soft appearance does not establish accessibility compliance.

Keep soft surfaces and moderate rounding, but give buttons, fields and selected states identifiable boundaries and contrast. Use gentle shadows only as supporting depth cues. Make keyboard focus and errors independently visible.

zh-CN.name: 故事叙事型

有真实素材能支持完整叙事。
avoid_when: 赶时间的用户仍应能直达功能或结果。
不要以强制滚动与自动播放代替信息组织。

en.name: Storytelling-Driven
en.description: A content approach that connects a problem, exploration and outcome in a meaningful sequence. It helps explain product significance without requiring forced scrolling or continuous animation.

Authentic material supports the narrative.
avoid_when: Time-sensitive users should still reach features or outcomes directly.
Do not substitute scroll hijacking or autoplay for information structure.

Expressive proportions must not break reading or interaction consistency.

en.description: Distinguish the selected option and support keyboard selection; this demo illustrates the visual state change.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Transition the selected tab to a dark background and light text over {duration_ms}ms. Keep one selected option and expose its semantic state and keyboard access. Switch instantly for reduced motion.

zh-CN.name: 信任权威型
zh-CN.description: 工作用页面标签：通过透明的主体信息、可验证证据、清楚的产品限制和稳定体验建立信任。视觉上的正式感或徽章本身不构成权威认证。
use_when: 用户作决定前需要确认来源、责任主体和限制。
产品可提供可核实的支持信息。
avoid_when: 不要使用未经授权的认证标识或合作品牌。
不能把承诺与案例写成结果保证。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
清楚展示产品提供方、联系渠道、能力边界与可核实证据；证书或合作关系注明来源和适用范围；把关键费用、隐私处理和风险放在相关操作之前，避免仅靠装饰徽章建立信任。
专属演示：可展开依据、更新时间与能力限制，展示透明信息，不使用虚构认证。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Trust & Authority
en.description: A working page label for building trust through transparent identity, verifiable evidence, clear product limits and a dependable experience. A formal visual tone or badge alone does not establish accreditation.
use_when: Users need to understand provenance, accountability and limitations before deciding.
The product can provide verifiable supporting information.
avoid_when: Do not display unauthorized certifications or partner logos.
Do not turn promises or case studies into guaranteed outcomes.
en.prompt_template:
Show the provider, contact routes, capability limits and verifiable evidence. Attribute certifications or partnerships and explain their scope. Present important costs, privacy handling and risks before relevant actions instead of relying on decorative badges.
Dedicated demonstration: Expandable evidence, an update date and capability limits demonstrate transparent information without fabricated credentials. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 用户行为分析
zh-CN.description: 围绕用户操作路径、事件、群组和任务结果分析产品使用情况。事件记录、热区或漏斗并不能直接解释用户为什么行动，需要结合定义、隐私边界与其他研究。
use_when: 希望找出任务路径中的流失或操作阻碍。
事件定义与数据采集范围透明且合适。
avoid_when: 不能将点击行为直接当作心理动机。
不要默认采集敏感输入或可识别个人数据。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
按用户任务展示事件路径和漏斗，说明事件定义、时间范围与样本；区分观察事实与原因假设，提供群组比较和数据缺失提示；减少个人可识别信息，仅显示任务必要的数据。
专属演示：示例访问、探索和完成的漏斗与路径视图，切换视图保留统一样本说明。 参数：内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: User Behavior Analytics
en.description: Analyzing product use through action paths, events, cohorts and task outcomes. Events, heatmaps and funnels do not directly explain user motivation; interpretation needs clear definitions, privacy boundaries and complementary research.
use_when: The team needs to identify drop-off or friction within task paths.
Event definitions and data collection boundaries are transparent and appropriate.
avoid_when: Do not treat click behavior as direct evidence of motivation.
Do not collect sensitive input or identifiable personal data by default.
en.prompt_template:
Show event paths and funnels organized by user task, with event definitions, time ranges and sample information. Distinguish observations from causal hypotheses, support cohort comparison, and disclose missing data. Minimize identifiable information and show only task-relevant data.
Dedicated demonstration: A sample visit/explore/complete funnel and path view; switching views retains the sample explanation. Parameters: content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 蒸汽波
zh-CN.description: 以怀旧数字媒介意象、粉紫或青色调、网格与拼贴表现疏离的复古氛围。它是宽泛审美方向，不能把风格化噪点、失真与低对比强加给功能文本。
use_when: 音乐、活动或作品展示需要特定的怀旧情绪。
有合适素材与明确的版权来源。
avoid_when: 不要使用失真字体展示关键说明或操作标签。
避免无必要的闪烁与持续噪点动画。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在封面与背景使用受控的怀旧数字拼贴和粉紫青色调，正文放在稳定的高对比表面；功能入口清楚可辨；噪点和失真仅作有限装饰，减少动态效果时移除非必要动画。
专属演示：落日、透视格线与低饱和复古渐变，播放有限时长的光景变化。 参数：视觉强度 {intensity}；演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Vaporwave
en.description: A broad aesthetic using nostalgic digital imagery, pink-purple or cyan tones, grids and collage for a detached retro atmosphere. Stylized noise, distortion and low contrast should not be imposed on functional text.
use_when: Music, campaigns or portfolios need a specific nostalgic atmosphere.
Suitable imagery has clear usage rights.
avoid_when: Do not use distorted typography for essential instructions or action labels.
Avoid unnecessary flicker and continuous animated noise.
en.prompt_template:
Use controlled retro digital collage and pink-purple-cyan tones in covers or backgrounds. Place body text on stable high-contrast surfaces and keep actions recognizable. Limit noise and distortion to decoration, removing nonessential animation when motion is reduced.
Dedicated demonstration: A sunset, perspective grid and muted retro gradients; play a finite ambient transition. Parameters: visual intensity {intensity}; demo duration {duration_ms}ms.

zh-CN.name: 高饱和色块
zh-CN.description: 工作用视觉标签：以明确边界的大色块和较高饱和度建立分区与视觉节奏。色块需要服务层级，不能让不同功能只靠颜色来区分。
use_when: 品牌需要活力且内容可以分成清楚模块。
色彩系统能保证文字与背景对比。
avoid_when: 大量等强度色块会争夺注意力。
颜色不能替代标签、图标或状态说明。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
用有限的高饱和色块区分主要内容模块，为每个背景选择可读文字色；保留明确标题和稳定间距；主操作采用独立识别提示，减少同时竞争的强调色。
专属演示：大面积高饱和色块按任务分组，真实切换当前任务的强调色。 参数：强调色 {accent}；内容间距 {gap_px}px。

en.name: Vibrant & Block-based
en.description: A working visual label for bold, clearly bounded color blocks that organize sections and create rhythm. Color should support hierarchy rather than be the only way to distinguish functions.
use_when: The brand needs an energetic tone and content has clear modules.
The palette can maintain readable text against every surface.
avoid_when: Many equally intense blocks compete for attention.
Color cannot replace labels, icons or state explanations.
en.prompt_template:
Use a limited set of vibrant blocks to separate main content modules, choosing readable text colors for each surface. Retain clear headings and stable spacing. Give primary actions independent recognition cues and avoid competing emphasis colors.
Dedicated demonstration: Large saturated blocks group tasks; switch the active task and its emphasis. Parameters: accent color {accent}; content gap {gap_px}px.

zh-CN.description: 利用字号、字重、位置和对比安排阅读顺序，突出当前最重要的信息。

为页面建立清晰阅读顺序：主标题、辅助说明、主要操作分别使用可区分的尺寸与对比；保持一个明确的首要动作。

zh-CN.name: 留白
zh-CN.description: 通过未被内容占用的空间分组与突出信息，而不是简单把所有距离放大。

en.name: Whitespace
en.description: Use unoccupied space to group and emphasize information, rather than enlarging every gap.

Keep spacing within groups smaller than spacing between groups. Use whitespace to support reading order, and check content continuity on narrow screens.
Dedicated demonstration: Compact and spacious layouts side by side; adjust actual content padding to observe grouping. Parameters: content padding {space_px}px.

zh-CN.name: Y2K 美学
zh-CN.description: 借用世纪之交数字媒介常见的金属感、亮色、像素或塑料质感等意象表达复古数字氛围。它是宽泛审美标签，并不要求把老式界面的操作缺陷一并复制。
use_when: 品牌或活动希望表达复古数字氛围。
视觉素材与目标受众的语境相符。
avoid_when: 不能用像素字体和高光材质牺牲长文本阅读。
不要把装饰窗口做成误导性的系统提示。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
在标题、图像与少量装饰中使用金属或复古数字意象；正文和表单采用清楚的现代排版与操作反馈；明确区分装饰窗口与真正交互，保留无装饰的内容阅读区域。
专属演示：金属渐变、鼓起胶囊与星形徽记，点击切换镀铬面板的状态。 参数：材质高光透明度 {shine}；圆角 {corner_px}px。

en.name: Y2K Aesthetic
en.description: A broad aesthetic drawing on turn-of-the-century digital motifs such as metallic surfaces, bright colors, pixels or plastic-like textures. It evokes digital nostalgia without requiring the interaction flaws of old interfaces.
use_when: A brand or campaign seeks a nostalgic digital tone.
The imagery fits the intended audience and context.
avoid_when: Do not sacrifice long-text legibility for pixel fonts or glossy materials.
Do not make decorative windows look like deceptive system messages.
en.prompt_template:
Use metallic or retro digital motifs in headings, imagery and selected decoration. Keep body copy and forms readable with clear contemporary feedback. Distinguish decorative windows from actual interaction and preserve quiet content-reading areas.
Dedicated demonstration: Chrome gradients, inflated capsules and star emblems; click to change the chrome panel state. Parameters: material highlight opacity {shine}; corner radius {corner_px}px.

zh-CN.name: 零界面
zh-CN.description: 用语音、环境感知或其他低屏幕依赖方式完成任务的方向性标签。“零界面”不表示没有交互设计；用户仍需要知道系统状态、控制权限以及如何退出或纠正。
use_when: 任务适合非视觉通道且用户能够明确控制。
有可靠的状态反馈和替代操作方式。
avoid_when: 不能默认持续监听或隐瞒数据采集。
语音或手势不能成为排他的唯一通道。
zh-CN.prompt_template:
减少对屏幕的依赖，但为启动、监听、执行和结束提供明确反馈；说明采集范围与权限，提供停止、纠正和撤销方式；为不能使用主要通道的用户保留可访问的替代入口。
专属演示：按住按钮模拟语音状态，并提供真实文字输入替代；不读取麦克风、不联网。 参数：演示时长 {duration_ms}ms。

en.name: Zero Interface
en.description: A directional label for tasks using voice, ambient sensing or other methods with less dependence on screens. It does not eliminate interaction design: users still need status, control, consent and ways to exit or correct the system.
use_when: The task suits nonvisual channels and users can maintain control.
Reliable status feedback and alternative interaction methods are available.
avoid_when: Do not default to continuous listening or conceal data collection.
Voice or gesture must not become an exclusive interaction channel.
en.prompt_template:
Reduce screen dependence while giving explicit feedback for activation, listening, execution and completion. Explain data collection and permissions, provide stop, correction and undo, and retain accessible alternatives for users who cannot use the main channel.
Dedicated demonstration: Hold a button to simulate voice states, with a real text-input alternative; no microphone access or network request. Parameters: demo duration {duration_ms}ms.
